status_note: Candidate master design for owner approval (Master Guide §3/§14: the approved master design is still TBD). Do not treat as approved until recorded in docs/decisions/CHANGELOG.md.
design_source: A4 Cozy Storytelling character anchor (third_party/kaomei-stickman-video-director/references/cozy-storytelling.md), reimplemented as a code rig. No Milo traits.
design_anchor_prompt: One minimalist 2D cartoon protagonist with a white filled circular head, two small dark oval eyes, simple eyebrow strokes and a short curved mouth. The torso is a slim closed tapered shape with solid white fill inside its dark outline. Both arms and both legs are dark single-line strokes with constant medium weight; hands are small dark rounded shapes and feet are short dark rounded strokes. No hair or clothing accessories. Keep the same head-to-body proportions, white head and torso fill, and outline weight in every shot. Exactly two arms and two legs exist.
units: pixels at scale 1 on a 1080-wide frame; origin = ground point under the hips, +y down
proportions_summary: Total height ≈ 426 px at scale 1 (head Ø 112, torso 150, legs 174): head ≈ 26% of height.
